race.description: Non Thinkers Sports Bar @ Port City Bowling Club Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SARMAT (2) improved from first to second run this campaign. He looks to get a charmed run all the way and the betting last run suggests he is ready to be winning this sort of race. ATADCHEEKY (3) has generally been about the same in recent efforts. He will get back in the field so will need some fortune. Should hit the line. IRISH ACCOLADE (8) went a lot better two weeks back. Just hasn't had any luck at the barriers. SLEUTH (13) has never run well when resuming so look for better. This is a much better distance range. BIRDY GIRL (4) is another who will get back. But she does find the line all the time.
